audit_events_tenant_pair.name: audit_events_tenant_pair
audit_events_tenant_pair.value: ("audit_events"."merchant_id" is null and "audit_events"."environment_id" is null) or "audit_events"."merchant_id" is not null

chain_orders_verification_consistent.name: chain_orders_verification_consistent
chain_orders_verification_consistent.value: ("chain_orders"."canonical_status" = 'none' and "chain_orders"."last_verified_at" is null) or ("chain_orders"."canonical_status" <> 'none' and "chain_orders"."last_verified_at" is not null)

chain_orders_block_evidence_pair.name: chain_orders_block_evidence_pair
chain_orders_block_evidence_pair.value: ("chain_orders"."last_verified_block" is null and "chain_orders"."last_verified_block_hash" is null) or ("chain_orders"."last_verified_block" >= 0 and "chain_orders"."last_verified_block_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$')

payment_intents_checkout_path_safe.name: payment_intents_checkout_path_safe
payment_intents_checkout_path_safe.value: "payment_intents"."checkout_path" is null or ("payment_intents"."checkout_path" like '/pay/%' and length("payment_intents"."checkout_path") <= 256)

payment_intents_observation_consistent.name: payment_intents_observation_consistent
payment_intents_observation_consistent.value: ("payment_intents"."canonical_status" = 'none' and "payment_intents"."canonical_observed_at" is null) or ("payment_intents"."canonical_status" <> 'none' and "payment_intents"."canonical_observed_at" is not null)

webhook_deliveries_delivery_consistent.name: webhook_deliveries_delivery_consistent
webhook_deliveries_delivery_consistent.value: (("webhook_deliveries"."status" = 'delivered' and "webhook_deliveries"."delivered_at" is not null) or ("webhook_deliveries"."status" <> 'delivered' and "webhook_deliveries"."delivered_at" is null))

webhook_deliveries_lease_pair.name: webhook_deliveries_lease_pair
webhook_deliveries_lease_pair.value: (("webhook_deliveries"."lease_owner" is null and "webhook_deliveries"."lease_until" is null) or ("webhook_deliveries"."lease_owner" is not null and "webhook_deliveries"."lease_until" is not null))
